# Tobo

> > Tobo is a multilingual vocabulary learning platform offering translations, pronunciation guides, and themed flashcard courses across English, Russian, Chinese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, and other languages.

The platform specializes in visual vocabulary building with themed courses covering topics like animals, everyday objects, and geography. Tobo provides bilingual dictionaries with audio pronunciation for learners studying multiple language pairs, with a strong focus on Russian as a target or source language.

## Key Topics

- Language learning and vocabulary acquisition
- Russian translation services
- Multilingual dictionaries (English, Chinese, Korean, Turkish, Polish)
- Themed vocabulary courses (Animals, everyday objects)
- Pronunciation guides and audio learning
- Visual flashcards and image-based learning
- Country and geography vocabulary (Южная Корея, Япония, Германия, США, Франция, Италия, Испания)
- Bilingual word pairs and translation
- Vocabulary lists by topic
- Cross-language learning tools

## Themed Vocabulary Courses

- ["Животные" на турецком языке](https://www.toboapp.com/ru/kurs/zhivotnie-turetskiye-slova-po-temam/): Turkish vocabulary course: Animals theme with flashcards and images
- ["Животные" на польскком языке](https://www.toboapp.com/ru/kurs/zhivotnye-polskiye-slova-po-temam/): Polish vocabulary course: Animals theme with flashcards and images

## Translation Dictionary

- [Как сказать "пазл" на английском?](https://www.toboapp.com/word/english/russian/jigsaw-puzzle-376/): English-Russian translation for 'jigsaw puzzle' with pronunciation
- [Как сказать "рыба" на китайском?](https://www.toboapp.com/word/chinese/russian/yu-377/): Chinese-Russian translation for 'fish' (鱼) with pronunciation
- [Как сказать "магазинная тележка" на английском?](https://www.toboapp.com/word/english/russian/shopping-cart-2340/): English-Russian translation for 'shopping cart' with pronunciation
- [Как сказать "Южная Корея" на корейском?](https://www.toboapp.com/word/korean/russian/daehanminguk-1308/): Korean-Russian translation for 'South Korea' (대한민국) with pronunciation
